content: The Machine Reading Comprehension is a task which takes a question INLINEFORM0 and a passage/paragraph INLINEFORM1 as inputs, and aims to find an answer span INLINEFORM2 in INLINEFORM3 . We assume that if the question is answerable, the answer INLINEFORM4 exists in INLINEFORM5 as a contiguous text string; otherwise, INLINEFORM6 is an empty string indicating an unanswerable question. Note that to handle the unanswerable questions, we manually append a dumpy text string NULL at the end of each corresponding passage/paragraph. Formally, the answer is formulated as INLINEFORM7 . In case of unanswerable questions, INLINEFORM8 points to the last token of the passage.
